# Erken Systems — The Receptionist for flight schools

> The Receptionist is a 24/7 AI receptionist for flight schools. It answers every call, text, and website chat, and books discovery flights straight into the school's calendar.

## What it does

- Answers phone calls around the clock with a voice agent that knows flight-school basics: discovery flights, Part 61 and Part 141 training, weather cancellations.
- Texts back missed calls within seconds and handles after-hours website chat.
- Books discovery flights into the school's calendar, sends booking reminders, and rebooks after weather cancellations.
- Forwards a summary to the owner when it cannot answer a question, instead of guessing.

## Pricing

- $97 per month, $197 one-time setup. No contract; cancel anytime.

## Ideal customer

- Owner-operated US flight schools, roughly 1–10 aircraft, where calls go unanswered during flying hours, evenings, and weekends.
